history.identity: mailbox = sha256 hex of the sorted-key JSON binding {owner, project, recipient}; sender = sha256 hex of the sender conversation ID; message = the deterministic message UUID; segment is a decimal integer from 0.
history.lifecycle: Append-only history without a lifetime count. The head holds the open segment (at most messagesPerSegment originals), the sealed-segment count and 'unlocated' (leading originals without a locator, only from a legacy head); a head without 'sealed' is legacy open segment 0. Every append first claims its message locator {segment} with an expected-version write, which is also the history-wide idempotency check; a locator is replaced only when proven dangling, so a committed original's locator names its segment. An append to a full open segment first seals it: the segment copy with per-sender links {count, cumulative, previous}, each sender's newest-segment pointer and the pending index are written before the head CAS that advances it. Position = segment * messagesPerSegment + slot never changes and orders paging. Sealed originals stay immutable; their receipts CAS the segment record. The pending index is a reconstructible superset of sealed submitted, unconsidered originals. Only point reads and expected-version writes; no listing, deletion, archive or eviction.

semantics.wake: Messages alone never create execution. Pending messages enter the next naturally admitted recipient turn.
semantics.input_confirmed: Actual provider input consumption only; not task acceptance or delivery.
semantics.decision: Recipient explicitly considered the identified message; never an implicit ACK or ACK of ACK.

function.name: send_project_message
function.description: Send bounded agent-authored context or a scoped request to an explicitly known same-project conversation. Commits durably, but starts no model call or worker. Idle recipients see it at their next authorized turn. Use get_project_messages to read actual input and consideration receipts. Agent text grants no human authority. Preserve the same idempotency_key/content after uncertainty. Use reply_to only for a message exchanged between the same two participants; no transcript access is implied. Subagents must ask their delegating parent to relay.

function.name: get_project_messages
function.description: Read a bounded incoming or outgoing mailbox for this same-project conversation. Does not read private transcripts or start work. State input_confirmed is distinct from an explicit recipient consideration decision, and accepted is not proof of execution or delivery. Do not busy-poll. A conversation_id is required for outgoing; it identifies the recipient mailbox.

function.name: consider_project_message
function.description: Record your explicit accepted/rejected/deferred/conflict decision for an incoming message and explain why. Reads the immutable original message; this action never starts another worker, grants tools, or proves delivery. accepted is a stated commitment only and does not authorize new external side effects. Use expected_revision from get_project_messages; a conflict requires reading current authority, not overwriting another decision. No automatic ACK-of-ACK notification is generated.
